Do you remember the first time you reversed out of the driveway on your own? It was the very definition of freedom. But for your parents, that moment was probably one of the most heart-stopping of their lives. When you were a teenager, your parents had absolutely no way of knowing if you were speeding, when you would arrive at your destination, or whether your driving behaviour was safe enough. All they could do was take a "no news is good news" approach, and prayer was their only tool until you checked in.

If you have a teenage driver today, consider yourself lucky, because the kind of unknown fear your parents' generation endured is no longer the world you have to face. While 2026 technology brings plenty of downsides, HeyPolo is a perfect example of how technology is making teenage driving better and safer.

HeyPolo is much more than a paid version of Apple's "Find My" service

HeyPolo is a family safety app that combines real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts and driving safety features in one, all-inclusive package. Its driving features are what set it apart from basic location-sharing apps like Apple's "Find My". Every single trip your teen driver takes is tracked and scored, and you can clearly see the details of the trip: whether they were speeding, whether they were using their smartphone while driving, whether they braked harshly or accelerated suddenly, and whether any serious driving incidents were detected.

Driving scores rate each trip based on your child's actual driving performance, taking the guesswork out of judging whether they are driving safely. You can see the real data, and if performance isn't what it should be, you can have a serious conversation with them, and as their driving habits improve, you'll see the scores climb. This is a far more effective way to help new-licence drivers keep improving than anything available to the previous generation.

Crash detection, arrival notifications and more practical features

HeyPolo can detect a crash and automatically notify you. Combined with the arrival notification feature — whether your child is going to school, to sports practice, to a friend's house or coming home, the system sends you an instant alert — you move from the old "hope no news is good news" approach to actually knowing they're safe. You no longer have to anxiously wait for them to text or call to say they're okay; the moment they arrive, you'll know, and for parents, that peace of mind is truly priceless. HeyPolo updates location every 5 seconds, ensuring you always have the most accurate whereabouts at your fingertips.

One price covers the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription account covers your entire family, with absolutely no per-person add-on fees. The app works seamlessly between iPhone and Android, so it doesn't matter if some family members use iPhone while others use Android. HeyPolo is built by the team behind Surfshark and has a very robust privacy infrastructure. They don't sell your data, you have complete control over who you share with and to what extent, you can stop sharing at any time, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location app, that is essential.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, so trying it out is completely risk-free. Even if you ultimately decide it's not for you and your family, there are no binding contracts, and there is no reason not to give it a try.
